title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 20 healthy participants performing a 7-day longitudinal motor imagery brain-computer interface (BCI) task without feedback. Each subject completed 7 sessions of 6 runs, imagining left hand, right hand, feet, and rest movements, yielding 33,600 trials in total. The dataset was converted to BIDS format from the original study by Zhou et al. (2021) examining the relationship between relative power and motor imagery decoding performance across time and subjects.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Neuroscan SynAmps2 system with 41 Ag/AgCl electrodes referenced to vertex (Cz) and grounded at AFz, sampled at 500 Hz with online bandpass (0.5-100 Hz) and notch (50 Hz) filtering. Participants performed 7 sessions of 6 runs each, imagining left hand, right hand, feet movements, or rest, with 5-second trial intervals cued visually via arrows.
